metadata.name: Iran FinOps Pricing Seed
metadata.scope: Iran-first public infrastructure pricing seed for deterministic FinOps calculations
metadata.important: Public websites change. Never treat this snapshot as live pricing. Production must run provider-specific sync jobs and keep price history.

providers.integration_strategy: official pricing sync + read-only API connector later
providers.notes: Best first adapter for deterministic resource-level pricing.

providers.integration_strategy: official pricing sync; billing/inventory connector after API verification
providers.notes: Clean hourly/monthly SKUs; useful for schedule-vs-always-on optimization.

providers.integration_strategy: official page sync; customer invoice import first; API later if documented
providers.notes: Strong fixed-SKU comparison case across Iranian datacenters.

providers.integration_strategy: official page sync + invoice import; API only after verification
providers.notes: Public crawler exposes general-purpose plans reliably; other families are dynamic.

providers.integration_strategy: official public plan scraper + invoice import; later authenticated connector
providers.notes: Plan catalog is large and dynamic; seed only currently visible official rows.

providers.integration_strategy: prefer official API over HTML configurator for complete catalog
providers.notes: Public page exposes a default calculator snapshot, not a full static SKU matrix.
Availability changes are important: some SKUs are explicitly sold out.

providers.integration_strategy: store only official starting-price snapshot until full plan source is available
providers.notes: Do not extrapolate component prices from the starting-price card.
